name: Verify user can correct proposed ticket type before submission
objective: Validate that the user can review and correct the proposed ticket type (Incident vs Service Request) before the ticket is created.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. Assistant has classified a request.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and describe an issue
steps.expectedResult: The assistant classifies the request (e.g., as Service Request)

steps.description: Indicate the classification should be different
steps.testData: "Actually this is an incident, my email stopped working"

steps.description: Verify the assistant updates the classification
steps.expectedResult: The ticket type is updated to Incident

steps.description: Verify the assistant proceeds with the corrected type
steps.expectedResult: The assistant continues the ticket creation flow using the corrected classification
